operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper states that a time-dependent optimal denoiser maps noisy coordinates at time t to predicted denoised coordinates. Existing sampling, update, addition, projection, and self-attention operations do not represent a learned diffusion denoiser with an explicit time-conditioned coordinate output.

The catalog has no operation for composing heterogeneous energy or gradient conditioners.
